pattern: に難くない（にかたくない）
purpose: Say that a feeling or situation is easy to infer.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
It is easy to imagine his joy.
It is easy to understand the family’s anxiety.
It is not hard to imagine confusion arising.
restrictions: Most common with 想像する and 察する.
mistake: 難くない is read かたくない here.
